before: A field result refresh refused text with a line break, so a REF whose bookmark held one kept its stale saved result.
after: A field result refresh writes each line break as w:br inside the plain result run, and treats result runs with line breaks as plain.
reason: The refresh writes ordinary w:t, w:tab and w:br nodes that released participants already read and synchronize. No shared format field changes. Form field edits keep the earlier plain-run rules.
